purpose: Teach: むかし/みち/帰ら/叩き/割っ/削り/好か/きらい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、むかしのお店、懐かしいよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Coming back to the old place… it really does feel like a lifetime ago, doesn't it?
lines.style: Soft, wistful opening. Gentle pause after the first clause. Warm but tinged with melancholy. Voice trails into the question like she's inviting Aoi to share the memory, not asking for confirmation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店までのみち、迷ったわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I actually got lost on the way here. Can you believe that?
lines.style: Lighthearted, self-deprecating laugh underneath. Slight shake of the head in the delivery. Not dwelling on it—bright enough to make Aoi smile at her own mistake.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、今日は早く帰らせるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm going to send you home early today, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but decided. Not asking—offering with a care that doesn't need permission. Warm regard in the voice. The kind of thing said to someone you notice is tired.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お皿を叩きそうになっちゃった、メイちゃん
lines.en: I almost threw a plate just now. Almost lost it.
lines.style: Wry, self-aware laugh. Slight exaggeration for effect but real frustration underneath. Self-directed humor masking something genuine. Quick, almost dismissive delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、卵を割っておくね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've cracked the eggs ahead of time. Everything's ready.
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact. The voice of someone who prepares things so others don't have to think. Not showy—just practical care in motion. Quiet capability.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、鉛筆を削りに机に向かう、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm just going to sharpen some pencils at my desk for a bit.
lines.style: Quiet, almost to herself. A small break she's taking. Reflective pace. The rhythm of someone doing something with their hands to settle their mind. Understated.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店、お客様に好かれるとうれしい、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know what I love? When a customer really enjoys what we make for them.
lines.style: Warmer now. Eyes brighten in the voice. Genuine pleasure in the memory of a satisfied customer. Not performing—just sincere about the small joy of the work.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、辛いお料理きらいなお客様もいるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: But yeah, we have customers who really don't like spicy food. That's just how it is.
lines.style: Observant, accepting tone. No judgment—just noticing the reality. Close, conversational delivery, like sharing a small truth with someone she trusts. Gentle resignation.
